title: EHR to OMOP CDM Simulator
audience: Learners practicing how raw EHR-style data is transformed into an OMOP common data model structure.
objectives: Generate a synthetic source patient cohort.
Map source demographics into OMOP person table concept IDs.
Simulate condition occurrence records using ICD-10 source codes.
Explain why common data models improve cross-site research.

sections.name: Simulation Settings
sections.purpose: Set patient count and random seed for reproducible synthetic data.

sections.name: OMOP Person Table
sections.purpose: Map demographics to standardized concept IDs.

sections.name: Condition Occurrence
sections.purpose: Map source diagnosis codes into condition records.

chatbot_guidance: Explain ETL as extract, transform, and load.
Clarify why names and addresses disappear from the OMOP person table.
Explain concept IDs at a high level.
